root.name: トゥッツィー・ロール・インダストリーズ

relations.text: 最大の顧客(製品売上の約22.0%、2025年)
relations.text_en: Largest customer (about 22.0% of 2025 net product sales)

source.label: Tootsie Roll 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our net product sales from Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. ("Wal-Mart") aggregated approximately 22.0%, 23.2%, and 22.2% of net product sales during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

relations.text: 製品売上の約13.1%(2025年、Family Dollarを含む)
relations.text_en: About 13.1% of 2025 net product sales (including Family Dollar)

source.label: Tootsie Roll 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: ("Dollar Tree", which includes net sales from Family Dollar which is owned by Dollar Tree) 4 Table of Contents aggregated approximately 13.1%, 12.6%, and 14.2% of net product sales during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

relations.text: Walmart・Dollar Treeなどへ納品する卸。製品売上の19.7%(2025年)
relations.text_en: Wholesaler delivering to Walmart, Dollar Tree and others; 19.7% of 2025 net product sales

source.label: Tootsie Roll 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Net product sales revenues from McLane, which includes these Wal-Mart and Dollar Tree sales as well as sales and deliveries to other Company customers, were 19.7% in 2025 and 20.7% in 2024 and 20.1% in 2023.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
